cost: Misra-Gries and Space-Saving O(k) worst update and O(k) state with deterministic BTreeMap order; histogram O(1) update/O(b) query/state, b<=10^6; moments O(1) update/merge/state.
description: Summarize one accepted stream using bounded heavy-hitter counters, histogram rank/value intervals and online or merged moments.
forward: Summarize one accepted stream using bounded heavy-hitter counters, histogram rank/value intervals and online or merged moments.

Only shared successfully accepted inputs yield common N. There is no transaction across separate components. Exact counts, sorted ranks and direct finite mean/variance serve as independent fixture observations. The harness tests MG=SS jointly on 800 updates; histogram and moments use separate fixtures. A shared accepted-prefix execution across all four is not exercised.
inverse: Exclude frequency intervals omitting the exact accepted-stream count, rank/value rectangles omitting the sorted requested rank, mismatched accepted-prefix N and successful nonfinite moment output. A rejected individual update must not mutate that component; no cross-component rollback is promised.

Compatible streams lie in the intersection of frequency intervals, histogram bucket occupancies and moment constraints with execution consistency. Permutations and unrecorded identities/within-bucket values remain ambiguous; rounded moments may distinguish some permutations.
limitations: Frequency error/N, quantile value/rank intervals and floating variance are different metrics. Moment arithmetic has no universal relative-error certificate. Map allocation failure lies outside the Result contract; histogram allocation is fallible.
Finite tests and source-derived models are not a universal proof.
state: Accepted prefix counts agree under shared legal updates; counter, bucket and moment statistics retain different conservation and error relations.
